notes:
v1.5 - Milestone Update & Intelligence Refresh:
• Direct Notification Deep-Links: Tapping shop or person notifications opens their exact details screen instantly.
• Shop Details Visual Progress Graph: Visual progress bar showing Paid vs Remaining Due with percentage settlement badges.
• Bill Date Selector & Item Date Stamps: Select exact bill dates when creating/editing items, visible on every bill card & detail sheet.
• Daily 9:00 AM Automated Reminders: Automatic daily morning notifications for unpaid shopping bills and due/overdue debt obligations.
• Redesigned Luxury Update Dialog: High-contrast modal with System Update badge and release notes styling.
• Core Reliability & Safety Fixes: Unique notification IDs, case-insensitive store matching, and secure fallback states.
